purpose: Complete integrated method development; no component ablations this round
subset: exact frozen v5 development20; remaining80 forbidden until method freeze
schedule: all three GPUs independently load the same complete model; Omni Joint then AV, VideoLLaMA Joint then AV
pipeline: global structured observations for proposal compartment
global raw plus proposal notes yields provisional answer
only disagreement triggers fresh <=12s local observation when duration>12s
separate verifier sees raw global and fresh local only; no proposal/global notes/candidate answers
change native only when clean proposal and separate verifier agree
new_generation: greedy seed42 per call, native dtype/preprocessing; syntax-only tool observation grammar, no answer field and no constrained answer generation
memory: Two question-local compartments. Global generated notes condition proposal only; fresh local question-conditioned observation conditions verification only. Source hashes, actual windows, audio coverage recorded. This is context separation, not independent models or statistically independent observations.
revision: Agreement retains native. Disagreement requires separate evidence compartment verification. Unreadable/truncated proposal or unconfirmed revision retains native.

cost: new cold application-cache work plus reused native recorded seconds; initialization and technical pilot separately; OS cache uncontrolled

selection: One unified method across all four groups; complete whole round before next decision, retain all versions.
novelty_status: Research hypothesis: conditional acquisition with separated proposal and verification evidence. No established novelty or generalization gain. Same development20; no component ablations.
stop: one full round then evidence-based next-version review; no blind endless GPU occupation; OOM at most three process attempts per shard, other errors diagnosed

control_parser: Existing frozen label-blind joint_parser for baseline/proposal/verification, recognizes explicit answer+explanation, no change to primary scoring
